subject: semPaths for Second Order CFA WorkAround

messages.author: 9ab2460787fc70a3
messages.subject: semPaths for Second Order CFA WorkAround
parts:
Hi,

I am doing cfa on some categorical data. I was trying to define a second-order factor called PC as below and run the cfa on the define model. However, I was constantly getting an error that some objects are not found (e.g. Error in ~x + y + zx = ~Q32_1 + Q32_2 + Q32_4 : object 'y' not found).


HS.modelM <- ' PC=~ x + y + z    
              x  =~ Q32_1 + Q32_2 + Q32_4 
              y =~ Q42_1 + Q42_2 + Q42_3
              z  =~ Q43_6 + Q43_7 + Q43_8 '

Interestingly I could run the cfa on the first oder model so I thought the problem should have something to do with the second order construct.

HS.modelW <- '  x  =~ Q32_1 + Q32_2 + Q32_4 
                         y =~ Q42_1 + Q42_2 + Q42_3
                         z  =~ Q43_6 + Q43_7 + Q43_8 '



As suggested  in this link (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/lavaan/mv2QTvoAZQM) I found a workaround for calculating the fitmeasures. 

fit2  <- cfa(HS.modelW, 'PC =~ x + y + z', data=df, std.lv=T, std.ov=T)

However, the semPaths of the fit2 does not show the second-order PC. 

I would very much appreciate any suggestions.

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: semPaths for Second Order CFA WorkAround
parts:
From the error message, it looks like there is a line break missing. You might try putting another hard line break between the first and second syntax lines.
     If that doesn't work, you might try putting the second order syntax line at the end, instead of at the beginning.

HS.modelM <- '

x  =~ Q32_1 + Q32_2 + Q32_4 
              y =~ Q42_1 + Q42_2 + Q42_3
              z  =~ Q43_6 + Q43_7 + Q43_8

PC=~ x + y + z '

You might also consider fixing the first loading on PC to 1 and dropping the standardization of the factors.
